comment: Copy this file to config.json and customize for your environment

jira.jql: project = MYPROJ AND status != Done AND updated >= -30d ORDER BY updated DESC
jira.comment: JQL drives all issue selection — project, status, date range, labels, etc. The agent fetches whatever JQL returns and dispatches by issue type.

output.comment: Bug triage reports go to triages_dir; Story/Task plans go to plans_dir.

processing.comment: cutoff_date: YYYY-MM-DD — skip issues created before this date. null = 30 days ago.

issue_types.comment: Issue type names as they appear in your JIRA project. Add or remove to match your workflow.

notifications.comment: Set enabled=true and copy notifications.sample.json to notifications.json in the repo root

feedback.comment: post_to_jira: post triage/plan report as a comment on the JIRA issue after generation. private_comments: restrict comment visibility to visibility_role (recommended). visibility_role: JIRA role name that can see private comments (varies by project — common values: 'Service Desk Team', 'Developers', 'Administrators').

context.comment: Context files are read before each AI call. Learnings are appended after notable outcomes. rules_file is read-only (agents never write it).
